"""Story 7.1 : Architecture `raptor` (arbre de résumés par regroupement récursif)."""

import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from wavelibrarian import registry
from wavelibrarian.architectures._passages import lire_passages
from wavelibrarian.architectures.raptor import Raptor
from wavelibrarian.core.errors import ConfigError
from wavelibrarian.core.ids import sha16
from wavelibrarian.core.types import ParsedCorpus, Passage, QuestionInput
from wavelibrarian.llm.providers.fake import FakeProvider
from wavelibrarian.ports.components import ComponentSpec
from wavelibrarian.runner.context import Context as RunCtx
from wavelibrarian.runner.index_cache import IndexCache

PETITS = {"name": "fixed_tokens", "params": {"size": 40, "overlap": 5}}
REPONSE = '{"answer": "Réponse.", "citations": ["S1"], "abstain": false}'


@pytest.fixture
def ctx(tmp_path: Path):  # type: ignore[no-untyped-def]
    provider = FakeProvider()
    c = RunCtx.from_profile(
        "test", wl_home=tmp_path / "wl", run_id="r-1", seed=1, providers={"fake": provider}
    )
    c.parser = "markdown"
    c.provider = provider  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    with c:
        yield c


def _arch(ctx: RunCtx, **params: Any) -> Any:
    params.setdefault("embedder", {"name": "fake"})
    params.setdefault("chunker", PETITS)
    return ctx.build("architecture", ComponentSpec(name="raptor", params=params))


def _spans(ctx: RunCtx, step: str = "raptor.summarize") -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    lignes = (ctx.run_dir / "traces.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    return [s for s in map(json.loads, lignes) if s.get("wl.step", "").startswith(step)]


def _indexer(ctx: RunCtx, corpus: ParsedCorpus, dossier: Path, **params: Any) -> Any:
    arch = _arch(ctx, **params)
    with ctx.scope(post="indexing"):
        arch.index(corpus, dossier)
    return arch


def _question() -> QuestionInput:
    return QuestionInput(question_id="q-001", text="Que sait-on de la guilde Orvane ?", lang="fr")


def _synthetiques(arch: Any, n: int) -> None:
    """Remplace le chunker : `n` feuilles distinctes, toutes du même Document."""

    def chunk(doc: Any) -> list[Passage]:
        return [
            Passage(
                passage_id=sha16("feuille", str(i)),
                doc_id=doc.doc_id,
                text=f"feuille numéro {i} sujet {i * 7}",
                anchor_ids=(f"{doc.doc_id}#a{i}",),
            )
            for i in range(n)
        ]

    arch.chunker.chunk = chunk


def test_enregistrement_et_params(ctx: RunCtx) -> None:
    assert registry.get("architecture", "raptor") is Raptor
    assert Raptor.capabilities.incremental_update is False
    assert Raptor.capabilities.retrieval_method == "ranked"
    assert Raptor.query_params == frozenset({"k"})
    p = _arch(ctx).params
    assert (p.group_min, p.group_max, p.max_depth, p.k, p.summary_max_tokens) == (5, 10, 3, 5, 256)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "params",
    [
        {"group_min": 6, "group_max": 5},
        {"group_max": 1, "group_min": 1},
        {"max_depth": 0},
    ],
)
def test_params_invalides_refuses(ctx: RunCtx, params: dict[str, int]) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(Exception, match="group|max_depth"):
        _arch(ctx, **params)


def test_retriever_non_dense_refuse(ctx: RunCtx) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError, match="dense"):
        _arch(ctx, retriever={"name": "lexical"})


def test_minicorpus_invariants_des_noeuds(
    ctx: RunCtx, minicorpus: ParsedCorpus, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    _indexer(ctx, minicorpus, tmp_path / "i")
    passages = lire_passages(tmp_path / "i")
    par_id = {p.passage_id: p for p in passages}
    noeuds = [p for p in passages if p.level > 0]
    assert any(p.level == 0 for p in passages) and noeuds
    assert max(p.level for p in passages) <= 3
    for n in noeuds:
        assert n.child_ids and list(n.child_ids) == sorted(n.child_ids)
        enfants = [par_id[c] for c in n.child_ids]
        assert all(e.level < n.level for e in enfants)
        attendu = tuple(dict.fromkeys(a for e in enfants for a in e.anchor_ids))
        assert n.anchor_ids == attendu
        docs = {e.doc_id for e in enfants}
        assert n.doc_id == (next(iter(docs)) if len(docs) == 1 else None)
        assert n.passage_id == sha16("node", "raptor", str(n.level), *sorted(n.child_ids))
    assert any(n.doc_id is None for n in noeuds)  # le sommet couvre plusieurs Documents


def test_tailles_de_groupes_sur_23_feuilles(
    ctx: RunCtx, minicorpus: ParsedCorpus, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    arch = _arch(ctx)
    _synthetiques(arch, 23)
    with ctx.scope(post="indexing"):
        arch.index(minicorpus.model_copy(update={"documents": minicorpus.documents[:1]}), tmp_path)
    passages = lire_passages(tmp_path)
    niveaux = {n: [p for p in passages if p.level == n] for n in (0, 1, 2, 3)}
    assert len(niveaux[0]) == 23
    assert sorted(len(p.child_ids) for p in niveaux[1]) == [3, 10, 10]
    assert [len(p.child_ids) for p in niveaux[2]] == [3]
    assert niveaux[3] == []
    assert len(niveaux[2][0].anchor_ids) == 23


def test_profondeur_limitee_par_max_depth(
    ctx: RunCtx, minicorpus: ParsedCorpus, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    arch = _arch(ctx, group_min=2, group_max=2, max_depth=2)
    _synthetiques(arch, 16)
    with ctx.scope(post="indexing"):
        arch.index(minicorpus.model_copy(update={"documents": minicorpus.documents[:1]}), tmp_path)
    assert {p.level for p in lire_passages(tmp_path)} == {0, 1, 2}


def test_une_seule_feuille_sans_noeud_ni_appel(
    ctx: RunCtx, minicorpus: ParsedCorpus, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    arch = _arch(ctx)
    _synthetiques(arch, 1)
    with ctx.scope(post="indexing"):
        arch.index(minicorpus.model_copy(update={"documents": minicorpus.documents[:1]}), tmp_path)
    assert [p.level for p in lire_passages(tmp_path)] == [0]
    assert not (ctx.run_dir / "traces.jsonl").exists() or _spans(ctx) == []


def test_determinisme_octet_pour_octet(
    ctx: RunCtx, minicorpus: ParsedCorpus, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    _indexer(ctx, minicorpus, tmp_path / "a")
    _indexer(ctx, minicorpus, tmp_path / "b")
    a = (tmp_path / "a" / "passages.jsonl").read_bytes()
    assert a == (tmp_path / "b" / "passages.jsonl").read_bytes()


def test_appels_summarize_step_et_poste(
    ctx: RunCtx, minicorpus: ParsedCorpus, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    _indexer(ctx, minicorpus, tmp_path / "i")
    noeuds = [p for p in lire_passages(tmp_path / "i") if p.level > 0]
    spans = _spans(ctx)
    assert len(spans) == len(noeuds)
    assert all(s["wl.kind"] == "llm" and s["wl.post"] == "indexing" for s in spans)
    steps = sorted(s["wl.step"] for s in spans)
    assert steps == sorted(f"raptor.summarize.level{n.level}" for n in noeuds)


def test_resume_vide_repli_sur_concatenation(
    ctx: RunCtx, minicorpus: ParsedCorpus, tmp_path: Path, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
) -> None:
    ctx.provider.script("summarize", "raptor.summarize.*", "")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING):
        _indexer(ctx, minicorpus, tmp_path / "i")
    passages = lire_passages(tmp_path / "i")
    par_id = {p.passage_id: p for p in passages}
    n1 = next(p for p in passages if p.level == 1)
    assert n1.text == "\n\n".join(par_id[c].text for c in n1.child_ids)
    assert "résumé vide" in caplog.text


def test_question_niveaux_et_citations_vers_les_feuilles(
    ctx: RunCtx, minicorpus: ParsedCorpus, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    ctx.provider.script("generate", "generate*", REPONSE)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    arch, cle = IndexCache(tmp_path / "home").build(ctx, lambda: _arch(ctx, k=40), minicorpus)
    with ctx.scope(post="query", question_id="q-001"):
        rep = arch.answer(_question())
    niveaux = {s.passage.level for s in rep.retrieved}
    assert 0 in niveaux and max(niveaux) >= 1
    # Citation d'un nœud : [S1] sur chaque rang de nœud retrouvé
    anchors = {a for d in minicorpus.documents for a in d.anchors}
    premier = rep.retrieved[0].passage
    ctx.provider.script("generate", "generate*", REPONSE)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    assert set(a for a in premier.anchor_ids) <= anchors
    assert {c.anchor_id for c in rep.citations} == set(premier.anchor_ids)
    assert all(c.anchor_id in anchors for c in rep.citations)


def test_k_hors_cle_et_group_max_dans_la_cle(ctx: RunCtx) -> None:
    assert _arch(ctx, k=5).index_key() == _arch(ctx, k=3).index_key()
    assert _arch(ctx).index_key() != _arch(ctx, group_max=8).index_key()


def test_mise_a_jour_reconstruit_au_poste_update(
    ctx: RunCtx, minicorpus: ParsedCorpus, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    from wavelibrarian.corpus.scenario import appliquer_fichier

    scenario = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "corpora/minicorpus/scenario/scenario.yaml"
    change, apres = appliquer_fichier(minicorpus, scenario, parser="markdown")
    cache = IndexCache(tmp_path / "home")
    _, cle = cache.build(ctx, lambda: _arch(ctx), minicorpus)
    avant = len(_spans(ctx))
    maj, cle2 = cache.build(
        ctx, lambda: _arch(ctx), apres, post="update", change=change, old_dir=cache.path(cle)
    )
    nouveaux = _spans(ctx)[avant:]
    assert nouveaux and all(s["wl.post"] == "update" for s in nouveaux)
    sortants = set(change.removed) | {ancien for ancien, _ in change.modified}
    ancres_sortantes = {a for d in minicorpus.documents if d.doc_id in sortants for a in d.anchors}
    assert ancres_sortantes
    passages = lire_passages(cache.path(cle2))
    assert any(p.level > 0 for p in passages)
    assert not any(set(p.anchor_ids) & ancres_sortantes for p in passages)
    assert not any(p.doc_id in sortants for p in passages)
